conditions.condition_text: Wait for the EMA10 (fast, green) to cross above the EMA 20 (slow, orange) to signal bullish momentum.
The EMA10 tracks short-term momentum, and the EMA 20 represents the broader short to medium-term trend.
Check the CCI; it must be above zero at the time of the crossover or have crossed above zero shortly before to confirm momentum strength.
CCI measures how far the current price has moved away from its average price, indicating momentum strength.
Enter the trade only when both the EMA crossover and CCI confirmation are present. Entry can be on the close of the confirmation candle or a pullback to the EMA10.
Waiting for both signals aligns the entry with confirmed momentum.
Wait for the EMA10 to cross below the EMA 20 to signal bearish momentum.
The EMA10 tracks short-term momentum, and the EMA 20 represents the broader short to medium-term trend.
Check the CCI; it must be below zero at the time of the crossover or have crossed below zero shortly before to confirm bearish strength.
CCI measures how far the current price has moved away from its average price, indicating momentum strength.
Enter the trade when both the EMA crossover and CCI confirmation align.
Alignment of both signals confirms the strength of the move.

The speaker advises placing the stop below the most recent swing low or just below the EMA 20.
The speaker advises setting the target at least 1.5 to two times the distance of the stop loss.
